sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Cardano Builder DAO requests treasury funding for an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed DAO funding mechanism intended to allocate capital to Cardano builders based on KPIs.
Recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal administered by an independent dRep DAO council and multisig before milestone-based disbursement

Deliverables: Fund builders expected to improve Cardano monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL, Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions, Continue development of KPI tracking, including movement from self-reported tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data, Operate review, feedback, voting, milestone validation, and disbursement processes through a smart contract-governed DAO, Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury

Claim (adoption, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The Cardano Builder DAO is designed to allocate capital to builders who can improve Cardano's monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.

Claim (technical, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 1 using public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moving toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Claim (economic, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Round 1 included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, funded 20 companies, achieved 83% governance participation, and distributed 5,541,335 ADA.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

Independent evidence for: The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Independent evidence for: The DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain.

human_message:
BEACN records NO on Cardano Builder DAO. On the evidence available to BEACN's published review, the request does not clear the bar for spending shared treasury funds.

The action is a TreasuryWithdrawals. The cached anchor describes the request as: Cardano Builder DAO requests treasury funding for an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed DAO funding mechanism intended to allocate capital to Cardano builders based on KPIs. It asks the treasury for 20000000 ADA. The strongest grounded claim is: The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 1 using public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moving toward live on-chain Cardano data.

A material claim remains proposer-asserted or thinly supported: The Cardano Builder DAO is designed to allocate capital to builders who can improve Cardano's monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.

model_layer.note: Claim extraction and the plain-language message are model-assisted, advisory layers. The hard gates (stale data, missing evidence, treasury-needs-dossier, hard blockers, high flags) are deterministic and binding. The doctrine-aware reasoning layer records a bounded advisory lean of at most ±0.05, but it is not added to the binding score and cannot change the vote.
